body:
Hi Alberto,

Thanks.

Sorry, I attached another corrected translation. After that, probably only when it needs to be expanded due to some kind of development.

In recent weeks, I have prepared the reference manual of ART's editing tools in Hungarian. For this, I had to look at all editing tools, and in the meantime I also improved the Hungarian translation.
The reference manual in the ART documentation is quite incomplete. I created a complete and detailed reference manual for all ART editing tools and all 26 CTL scripts. It also became quite long. You can check it on my website if you are interested:
https://bykyny.hu/art-98.html

In addition, there are 19 articles on my website about the use of ART (and RawTherapee 12, darktable 6, Ansel 1, but I will no longer write about them), the table of contents of which can be found here:
https://bykyny.hu/raw-feldolgozas-a-gyakorlatban-bevezetes.html#tartalomjegyzek

And there's another article called "Which is the best free program for editing raw (RAW) files in 2024?" titled (ART is the best of course), which is located at
https://bykyny.hu/legjobb-ingyenes-raw-feldolgozo-2024.html

For CTL scripts, I also attached a corrected Hungarian translation.

[Magyar.txt](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/19141673/Magyar.txt)
